titulo: Live: Greta Thunberg joins French students on new day of nationwide protests
cuerpo: France faces fresh nationwide demonstrations on Tuesday as students, unions and opposition groups rally over poor school conditions, including teacher shortages and dilapidated buildings. Swedish activist Greta Thunberg has joined protesters outside a blockaded high school near Paris, boosting the movement’s visibility even as authorities warn that violence is intensifying despite a decline in school closures. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
